title: The Pulse: a new trend of CPU shortages
author: Ivan Klaric
description: After a GPU shortage and memory shortage driven by AI companies, we’re now experiencing a CPU shortage, thanks to AI agents using a lot more CPU with tool usage.
summary: Hi, this is Gergely with a bonus, free issue of the Pragmatic Engineer Newsletter. In every issue, I cover Big Tech and startups through the lens of senior engineers and engineering leaders.
takeaways: Source: Uber Increasingly, “agent requests” not only generate code which is inference-heavy – and therefore needs GPUs – but they also run tools that compile the code, run tests, run linters, and all of this is CPU-heavy.

The ‘memory crisis’ afflicting sectors like video gaming is well established and has been extensively covered in terms of shortages of GPUs, but now it seems like things are just as hard for businesses in need of CPUs from cloud providers.
As Reinforcement Learning (RL) is becoming a large amount of the workloads: RL needs a lot of CPUs.
